_comment: EP04 release (26 Nov 2026): hook opens on the pour (PHOOK, web snaps on పడింది, gem rolls on దొర్లిపోయాయి), R06 reveals the elephant on ఏనుగే; story passage from the one-clearing test (P01, PSPIDER close, PCOBRA slightly closer, PELEFIX with the web intact until the water snaps it on గూడు); name reveal spider/cobra/elephant on శ్రీ/కాళం/హస్తి, the three together on కలిపి పలకండి, S03 on శ్రీకాళహస్తి. Rendered, then head-trimmed at 5.0 s and given the blessing ending.

assets.S01: Macro: water pours from a trunk through the web; the web tears and the red gem rolls; tilt up to the trunk.
assets.S03: The Srikalahasti gopurams beside the Swarnamukhi river.
assets.S04: The forest clearing, the stone a dark shape in shadow.
assets.R04b: A tiny spider spins its web above the stone; sun on one half, rain beading on the other.
assets.R05: A real cobra leaves its burrow with a glowing gem in its mouth and sets it down near the stone.
assets.R06: A real elephant wades out of the stream, raises its trunk and pours water over the stone.
assets.R07: The cobra rears with its hood spread at the washed-aside gem and darts at the trunk tip; the trunk jerks up.
assets.R08: The elephant swings its head against the tree; the tree shudders, leaves fall; the small web on the bark trembles.
assets.R08b: Dusk: the elephant lies still at the foot of the tree; the torn web hangs above. No injury.
assets.S09: The clearing with the three offerings: the web, the red gem, the water.
assets.PHOOK: Shared clearing: the trunk pours onto the stone, the web stays whole until the water snaps it, then the gem rolls off into the stream (brief).
assets.P01: The clearing: branch over a stone on a ledge, stream on the right.
assets.PSPIDER: Close: the spider drops from the branch, fastens its strand, and the web fills in over the stone.
assets.PCOBRA: Slightly closer: the cobra rises at the right of the ledge, releases the gem beside the stone, slides away.
assets.PELEFIX: Shared clearing: the trunk comes in full, pours onto the stone; the water snaps the web; the gem rolls off the ledge into the stream.
assets.RVSPIDER: The spider at the centre of its web.
assets.P02: The clearing with the web over the stone.
assets.P03b: The clearing: web over the stone, the red gem beside it.
assets.P04b: After the pour: wet stone, torn web, the gem in the stream.
assets.PCOVER: The trunk pours onto the stone under the intact web, the red gem beside it.

segments.sees: Close on the small spider in its web on the bark.
Light falling through the trees onto the clearing (interim until S09b).
